entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Discriminator not updated when replacing TPH entity via Remove+Add with same ID — is this intentional in EF 9? #38300
  • ComplexProperty ToJson(): SaveChangesAsync throws 'ordinal -1 is invalid' when nested sub-collection grows (2+ JSON columns) #38299
  • Cosmos: Anonymous and dto projections filter undefined implicitly when projecting a single property #38298
  • Cosmos: introduce API for point reads (ReadItem) #38296
    Backlog

Closed

  • Allow keys and indexes to use properties on non-collection complex types #31246
    11.0.0
  • Allow defining indexes over JSON complex type columns #28605
    11.0.0
  • dotnet-ef --context * not working #38254
    11.0.0
  • Is there a good way to automate model scaffolding as part of the build process? #38295
  • SelectMany with inline array values over Where crashes ExpressionTreeFuncletizer with InvalidOperationException #38287
    11.0.0
  • Concat breaks with projections using external expression #38239
  • [Benchmarks] EFCore.Sqlite.Benchmarks silently fails since SQLitePCLRaw 3.x bump — missing bundle reference #38292
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Cosmos: translate top-level Any() to LIMIT 1 instead of EXISTS #38297

Merged

  • Support keys and indexes that traverse complex-type properties #38192
    api-review
  • fix: handle wildcard '*' in --context parameter #38269
    community-contribution
  • [Benchmarks] Reference SQLitePCLRaw.bundle_e_sqlite3 in EFCore.Sqlite.Benchmarks #38293
  • Fix funcletization of evaluatable lambda parameters #38291

Updated

  • Upgrade to XUnit v3 #38277
  • Wrap SIGN() in CAST(... AS int) for SQL Server #38260
